CVE-2024-0132.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit 1.16.1 or earlier contains a Time-of-che ...
CVE-2024-0132.description: NVIDIA Container Toolkit 1.16.1 or earlier contains a Time-of-check Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) vulnerability when used with default configuration where a specifically crafted container image may gain access to the host file system. This does not impact use cases where CDI is used. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to code execution, denial of service, escalation of privileges, information disclosure, and data tampering.

CVE-2024-0133.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit 1.16.1 or earlier contains a vulnerabili ...
CVE-2024-0133.description: NVIDIA Container Toolkit 1.16.1 or earlier contains a vulnerability in the default mode of operation allowing a specially crafted container image to create empty files on the host file system. This does not impact use cases where CDI is used. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to data tampering.

CVE-2024-0134.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit and NVIDIA GPU Operator for Linux contai ...
CVE-2024-0134.description: NVIDIA Container Toolkit and NVIDIA GPU Operator for Linux contain a UNIX vulnerability where a specially crafted container image can lead to the creation of unauthorized files on the host. The name and location of the files cannot be controlled by an attacker. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to data tampering.

CVE-2024-0135.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit contains an improper isolation vulnerabi ...
CVE-2024-0135.description: NVIDIA Container Toolkit contains an improper isolation vulnerability where a specially crafted container image could lead to modification of a host binary. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to code execution, denial of service, escalation of privileges, information disclosure, and data tampering.

CVE-2024-0136.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit contains an improper isolation vulnerabi ...
CVE-2024-0136.description: NVIDIA Container Toolkit contains an improper isolation vulnerability where a specially crafted container image could lead to untrusted code obtaining read and write access to host devices. This vulnerability is present only when the NVIDIA Container Toolkit is configured in a nondefault way. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to code execution, denial of service, escalation of privileges, information disclosure, and data tampering.

CVE-2024-0137.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit contains an improper isolation vulnerabi ...
CVE-2024-0137.description: NVIDIA Container Toolkit contains an improper isolation vulnerability where a specially crafted container image could lead to untrusted code running in the host’s network namespace. This vulnerability is present only when the NVIDIA Container Toolkit is configured in a nondefault way. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to denial of service and escalation of privileges.
